newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Talks between the government and the tribal Shanti Bahini leaders resume in Dhaka on Wednesday to end the decades-old insurgency in the Chittagong Hill Tracts region.
The cabinet on Wednesday approved the proposal for signing an agreement between Bangladesh and India for direct passenger communication between the two countries.

Finance Minister S A M S Kibria on Tuesday said he had asked the state-run Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) to increase its purchase of shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) to create a positive impact on the price situation.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Tuesday said that a bill for separation of judiciary from the executive would be placed in the parliament in its next session.
Former President H M Ershad on Tuesday brushed aside the notion that his Jatiya Party is a partner of the present government and said he would not "bear the failures" of the government.
The central bank has asked the commercial banks to raise the ceiling of credit to the share investors to bring back stability in the market.
Permission to launch merchant banks in the private sector is likley to be given by this month.

Remittances by Bangladeshis working abroad rose nearly 32 percent to Tk 41.90 billion in the first eight months of the curent fiscal year (July'96-Feb'97) over the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year.
